items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: One is a trumpet player, his name is Charlie Barberang. That's my brother Lucian's son.

ctx.x: That'll be a good one now when he gets it.

It'll be a good one, I think, when he gets it. I've heard him talk about it. Then I have a couple of nephews. One is a trumpet player, his name is Charlie Barberang. That's my brother Lucian's son. Then I have another nephew that's a wonderful trombone player. He's a New York City work post office. His name is Louie Barberang. That's Louie's son. That's Louie's son. So, it's a lot of musicians in the family.
Tell about the first music you ever heard when you were a kid. Was it the brass band?
